# @dxtmisha/test

> Modular Vue 3 UI testing and documentation harness library.

Provides dedicated test containers (`DxtTestPage`, `DxtTestBlock`), visual regression helpers, and interactive documentation widgets for testing DXT UI components.

## Key Components & Modules

- [DxtTestPage](src/components/DxtTestPage.vue): Root layout wrapper for component test suites.
- [DxtTestBlock](src/components/DxtTestBlock.vue): Isolated scenario container for rendering individual component states and props.
- [library.ts](src/library.ts): Barrel exporting all test harness components and utilities.

## Optional

- [README.md](README.md): Test harness usage guide and component examples.
- [package.json](package.json): Package dependencies and scripts.
